      "text": "PUT IN THE MORTAR {{ing_01|CELERY SEED}}, {{ing_02|DRY PENNYROYAL}}, {{ing_03|DRY MINT}}, {{ing_04|GINGER}}, {{ing_05|FRESH CORIANDER}}, {{ing_06|SEEDLESS RAISINS}}, {{ing_07|HONEY}}, {{ing_08|VINEGAR}}, {{ing_09|OIL}} AND {{ing_10|WINE}}; CRUSH IT TOGETHER [in order to make a dressing of it]."
